## Summary (human-written)
<!-- Write this yourself, not with an AI tool. 2-5 sentences: the problem, why
     this approach, and what you checked yourself. -->

## Why

Reduce test maintenance by removing redundant coverage and checks that unnecessarily lock in implementation details, while preserving meaningful regression tests.

## What changed

- Remove **65 test functions**: 43 core CPU, 11 core GPU, 8 RL CPU, and 3 experiment tests. Parameterized functions are counted once; this is not a count of expanded pytest cases. The complete inventory and per-test reasons are below.
- Remove one redundant 8-GPU `features` integration entry, `3d`, and its now-unused config factory. Keep `pp_dp_tp`, which runs the same training configuration with checkpoint save/load.
- Extend the existing `.claude/rules/tests.md` guidance to reject private-layout snapshots and assertions that only repeat mock calls, and require naming retained coverage before deleting a redundant test. The PR-review skill already references this rule file.
- Mechanically move four fused-SwiGLU checkpoint/adapter tests from the GPU suite to `tests/unit_tests/cpu/recipes/test_fused_swiglu.py`; retain the two accelerator forward-parity tests in the GPU suite. Test bodies and decorators are unchanged. Existing CI discovers both directories, so no workflow edit is needed.
- Mechanically remove imports, helpers, empty classes and section banners left unused by deleted tests. Retained test function bodies and decorators are unchanged (AST comparison against `8e3da8b50b`).

Production code, recipes, numerical goldens and CI workflow files are unchanged. In particular, these semantic RL guards remain:

- `tests/rl/unit_tests/cpu/test_rl_dist_moe_recipe.py::test_rl_integration_recipe_runs_dist_moe_on_both_roles`
- `tests/rl/unit_tests/cpu/test_model_defaults.py::test_rl_recipes_get_model_defaults` (LM-head precision and frozen routing across recipes)

The B200 integration and CPU RL workflows still invoke those checks. Compiler-lowering checks, model/dataset geometry checks, numerical/gradient comparisons and real-collective coverage also remain. The MoE backend-selection, Qwen 27B full-rematerialization, DAPO thinking-mode, 671B precision/fusion, dataset absolute-path and Generator finalizer and profiler output-directory guards are retained.

The four moved tests are retained and are not included in the deletion count:

- `TestFusedSwiGLU.test_saves_native_layout_without_copy`
- `TestFusedSwiGLU.test_fused_roundtrip`
- `TestFusedSwiGLUDistGemmComposition.test_overlapping_variant_keeps_w13_checkpoint_layout`
- `TestFusedSwiGLUHFAdapter.test_hf_adapter_roundtrip`

## Deleted tests and reasons

Each entry explains why the test is being removed. References to existing coverage identify retained tests.

<details>
<summary>Core CPU: 43 test functions</summary>

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/checkpointer/test_checkpoint.py`**

- `TestCheckpointManager.test_checkpointer_package_import_path`: Remove because retained fresh-process checks exercise the public CheckpointManager import, and retained ModelWrapper/optimizer tests use the public exports. The extra assertion fixes re-export identity with the implementation modules; it does not exercise additional checkpoint behavior.
- `TestCheckpointManager.test_legacy_import_path`: Remove because the public CheckpointManager import is covered by retained fresh-process tests and public ModelWrapper is exercised by state-dict and export tests. This test adds only exact identity with their implementation-module classes.
- `TestCheckpointManager.test_trainer_uses_optional_checkpointer_interface`: Remove because ConfigLoader does not use this annotation to parse configuration, and in-repo recipes explicitly select their checkpointer. The exact DCP type/default snapshot does not exercise the runtime None/build branches.
- `TestConfigPostInit.test_legacy_config_only_adds_dcp_specific_fields`: Remove because it fixes which fields are declared locally on a subclass; redeclaring an inherited field unchanged would fail it. Retained config validation and save/load tests check the effective configuration.
- `TestSharedDiscoveryAndRetention.test_bodies_are_defined_on_the_base`: Remove because moving methods between base and derived classes need not change their results; the retained TestSharedDiscoveryAndRetention cases check discovery and retention decisions directly.
- `TestShouldPurge.test_defined_on_the_base_not_the_dcp_manager`: Remove because method ownership is not the purge contract; the remaining TestShouldPurge cases check rank, retention and folder conditions regardless of where the method lives.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/checkpointer/test_state_dict_keys.py`**

- `TestStateDictKeys.test_model_structure_anchors`: Remove because fixed debug-model parameter names add no checkpoint roundtrip coverage. Retained tests compare every actual parameter key and optimizer-state value, allowing supported native-layout changes.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/checkpointer/test_torch_checkpointing.py`**

- `TorchCheckpointingManagerTest.test_config_adds_no_checkpoint_options`: Remove because valid backend-specific options would fail an exact match with the base field set; serialization and backend-configuration behavior have separate retained tests.
- `TorchCheckpointingManagerTest.test_legacy_config_has_no_backend_selector`: Remove because absence of two old attribute names does not establish correct backend selection. Retained test_config_builds_independent_manager and save/load tests check which manager actually runs.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/data/test_grain_data.py`**

- `test_hf_lineage_fields_are_serialized`: Remove because both sources use the unchanged generic serializer: nested-config serialization tests cover that mechanism, and test_hf_explicit_fields_are_passed_to_load_dataset checks all four HF fields for both sources.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/data/test_mm_dataset_preprocessing.py`**

- `TestProcessMmSampleTemporalPatchSize.test_process_mm_sample_forwards_configured_temporal_patch_size`: Remove because correct preprocessing may inline or replace this helper; test_image_placeholders_match_across_temporal_patch_sizes checks the resulting placeholders without requiring that call structure.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/data/test_qwen_multimodal_data.py`**

- `test_multimodal_registry_does_not_enable_packing`: Remove because test_qwen_recipe_geometry_matches_dataset_processor already reads every registered processor, including cc12m, and catches an incompatible packing wrapper. **`tests/unit_tests/cpu/config/test_transforms.py`**

- `TestPublicApi.test_relation_graph_is_not_caller_configurable`: Remove because adding a valid optional argument need not change transform behavior; ordering and composition tests should determine correctness, not the permanent absence of a parameter name.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/models/common/test_cp_attention.py`**

- `TestCpGroup.test_cp_attention_holds_no_mesh_state`: Remove because it checks only that CPInnerAttention.__dict__ lacks the name cp_group; it cannot detect group state stored on an instance or under another name. Retained mesh-lookup and no-active-group tests check observable group behavior.

- `TestUlyssesVarlen.test_is_still_a_varlen_kernel`: Remove because test_dispatches_to_varlen_inner_attention executes the concrete Ulysses Varlen wrapper and checks its exact backend call and metadata. The additional config-inheritance assertions are weaker than that dispatch check.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/models/flux/test_flux_mxfp8_readme.py`**

- `test_flux_mxfp8_readme_custom_example_uses_converters`: Remove because harmless documentation rewrites can fail its string checks, while an invalid Python example can still pass. It neither executes the example nor verifies converter behavior.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/observability/test_profiler.py`**

- `TestProfilerConfig.test_build_returns_profiler_instance`: Remove because Configurable tests already cover the inherited build mechanism, while enabled-profiler tests check actual handles; a separate owner-type assertion adds no profiler-specific behavior.
- `TestProfilerConfig.test_custom_field_values`: Remove because it sets dataclass fields and reads the same values without using the profiler. Retained tests exercise enabled handles and memory-frequency selection; the removed assertions do not check schedule-option forwarding.

- `TestProfilerDisabledPaths.test_step_noop_when_both_profilers_none`: Remove because test_context_manager_step_is_noop already calls step twice with both profilers disabled.
- `TestProfilerInit.test_default_runtime_attrs`: Remove because test_active_updates_runtime_args already asserts the initial step and folder values, while the default-context test checks usable disabled handles. **`tests/unit_tests/cpu/observability/test_structured_logging.py`**

- `TestStepTags.test_step_tags_are_tuples`: Remove because the retained add-tag and multiple-tag tests already assert exact tuple results, and the concurrent-task test checks isolation. A shared mutable list would fail those existing assertions.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/recipes/test_debug_config_defaults.py`**

- `test_debug_config_default_seq_len`: Remove the duplicated list of debug-factory signature defaults. It does not construct a model or enforce a resource bound, and changing the shared constant would pass every assertion.
- `test_graph_trainer_debug_config_default_seq_len`: Remove because it requires every graph recipe to repeat the shared debug-length constant; it neither imposes a context limit nor exercises training, and valid per-model defaults would fail it.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/recipes/test_inference_moe.py`**

- `TestInferenceMoEComposition.test_grouped_linears_and_dispatcher_are_siblings`: Remove because this case rechecks grouped projections created by its own fixture and the dispatcher class explicitly passed to the transform. Retained composition tests execute that transform and verify the fused activation and generator/trainer dispatch modes.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_gc_freq.py`**

- `test_training_engine_owns_garbage_collector_defaults`: Remove because it snapshots GC field ownership and the default interval rather than running collection. Retained tests validate frequencies, build the collector and verify debug collection and freeze behavior.

**`tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_integration_test_definitions.py`**

- `test_b200_tests_are_registered_in_separate_suite`: Remove the exact suite-name inventory: adding a valid B200 case fails it, while changing a case to the wrong backend can still pass. The actual B200 jobs remain; this deletion stops pinning the complete name list.

- `test_h100_tests_are_registered_in_separate_suite`: Remove the exact suite-name inventory and obsolete-attribute checklist. They pin registration layout without verifying the advertised backends; the H100 jobs and their backend-specific execution remain.
- `test_llama3_debug_config_defaults_to_short_context`: Remove because integration recipes explicitly select their context lengths; this additional 2048 snapshot checks no model output or resource bound.
- `test_llama3_pp_numerics_has_one_microbatch_per_stage`: Remove because the retained models-suite PP numerical job uses this exact recipe, and Schedule1F1B rejects fewer microbatches than stages. The standalone inequality adds no extra validity check.

<details>
<summary>Core GPU: 11 test functions</summary>

**`tests/unit_tests/gpu/models/common/test_async_linear.py`**

- `TestAsyncTensorParallelSharding.test_w13_tp_shards_the_matrix_row_dimension`: Remove because test_stacked_w13_typechecks builds the same FFN, runs real _parallelize, and executes forward/backward on its two-rank CPU fallback. **`tests/unit_tests/gpu/models/kimi_k3/test_kimi_k3.py`**

- `TestFusedSwiGLUOverride.test_swiglu_config_is_replaced`: Remove because test_hf_adapter_roundtrip invokes the same factory, builds the model, and explicitly asserts FusedSwiGLU before checking checkpoint conversion; this standalone return-type assertion is duplicated.

**`tests/rl/unit_tests/cpu/test_bin_scheduler.py`**

**`tests/rl/unit_tests/cpu/test_trainer.py`**

- `test_rl_trainer_accepts_core_sdc_replay_config`: Remove because it only assigns a replay config and reads back its type; it cannot detect whether the RL trainer ever runs replay for that model/debug/graph combination.
- `test_rl_trainer_uses_training_engine_config_defaults`: Remove because it repeats TrainingEngine's inherited boolean default using a mock model; RL supplies no separate defaulting behavior. The test does not exercise graph capture.
- `test_trainer_has_thin_actor_adapter`: Remove the inheritance-tree checklist; retained forward/backward, state-restoration and close tests check contracts that remain meaningful across equivalent implementations.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Experiments: 3 test functions</summary>

**`torchtitan/experiments/graph_trainer/tests/test_autoparallel.py`**

- `test_autoparallel_integration_matrix`: Remove because it fixes only two job names and GPU counts and passes while both jobs are disabled. Retained pass/policy tests inspect AutoParallel behavior; this list snapshot does not establish execution.

**`torchtitan/experiments/graph_trainer/tests/test_chunked_loss.py`**

- `TestChunkedLossWrapperWithParamGrads.test_config_builds_param_grads_loss`: Remove because the enabled dense-Llama GraphTrainer numerical test loads the real recipe, builds its specialized chunked loss, binds lm_head, and computes explicit parameter gradients before comparing 20 training steps. A Config owner falling back to the base wrapper fails that execution path.

**`torchtitan/experiments/torchft/tests/test_torchft_trainer.py`**

- `test_ft_trainer_composes_specialized_training_engine`: Remove because test_ft_applies_ffn_lora_override_before_model_build enters the real FaultTolerantTrainer-to-engine initialization path, while retained tests check the FT all-reduce hook and replica-loss behavior. The two inheritance assertions add no engine-selection check.

- `features / 3d` in `tests/integration_tests/features.py`: remove because `pp_dp_tp` runs the same FSDP=2/TP=2/PP=2 training configuration and additionally checks save/resume; another 8-GPU run adds no distinct coverage. Its unused factory `llama3_debugmodel_fsdp2_tp2_pp2` is also removed.

This change removes redundant test definitions, moves CPU-runnable tests, and updates test guidance; it does not modify a training implementation or numerical golden. **Claude finished @tianyu-l's task in 2m 25s** —— [View job](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/41752086412)

**Claude finished @acisseJZhong's task in 1m 15s** —— [View job](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/actions/runs/41754309045)

---
**Approve**: all three earlier review items are fixed in `1ba63a5`. One item is left before merging: the empty "Summary (human-written)" section. [Review](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5786#pullrequestreview)

**Verdict: Approve -- please address the items below before merging.** The deleted tests check config values, class identity, or method ownership rather than behavior, and I spot-checked several of the "still covered by" claims; they hold. The one real problem is the new review-guidance section, which repeats `rules/tests.md` in the wrong file.

**What this PR does.** It deletes 65 test functions, deletes the `features / 3d` 8-GPU integration entry along with its config factory, and cleans up imports and helpers left unused by those deletions. It also adds a "Deciding Whether a PR Needs Tests" section to the `pr-review` skill. No production code, recipe, golden file, or CI workflow is changed.

## Summary (human-written)
<!-- Write this yourself, not with an AI tool. 2-5 sentences: the problem, why
     this approach, and what you checked yourself. -->

## Why

Reduce test maintenance by removing redundant coverage and checks that unnecessarily lock in implementation details, while preserving meaningful regression tests.

## What changed

- Remove **65 test functions**: 43 core CPU, 11 core GPU, 8 RL CPU, and 3 experiment tests. Parameterized functions are counted once; this is not a count of expanded pytest cases. The complete inventory and per-test reasons are below.
- Remove one redundant 8-GPU `features` integration entry, `3d`, and its now-unused config factory. Keep `pp_dp_tp`, which runs the same training configuration with checkpoint save/load.
- Extend the existing `.claude/rules/tests.md` guidance to reject private-layout snapshots and assertions that only repeat mock calls, and require naming retained coverage before deleting a redundant test. The PR-review skill already references this rule file.
- Mechanically move four fused-SwiGLU checkpoint/adapter tests from the GPU suite to `tests/unit_tests/cpu/recipes/test_fused_swiglu.py`; retain the two accelerator forward-parity tests in the GPU suite. Test bodies and decorators are unchanged. Existing CI discovers both directories, so no workflow edit is needed.
- Mechanically remove imports, helpers, empty classes and section banners left unused by deleted tests. Retained test function bodies and decorators are unchanged (AST comparison against `8e3da8b50b`).

Production code, recipes, numerical goldens and CI workflow files are unchanged. In particular, these semantic RL guards remain:

- `tests/rl/unit_tests/cpu/test_rl_dist_moe_recipe.py::test_rl_integration_recipe_runs_dist_moe_on_both_roles`
- `tests/rl/unit_tests/cpu/test_model_defaults.py::test_rl_recipes_get_model_defaults` (LM-head precision and frozen routing across recipes)

The B200 integration and CPU RL workflows still invoke those checks. Compiler-lowering checks, model/dataset geometry checks, numerical/gradient comparisons and real-collective coverage also remain. The MoE backend-selection, Qwen 27B full-rematerialization, DAPO thinking-mode, 671B precision/fusion, dataset absolute-path and Generator finalizer and profiler output-directory guards are retained.

The four moved tests are retained and are not included in the deletion count:

- `TestFusedSwiGLU.test_saves_native_layout_without_copy`
- `TestFusedSwiGLU.test_fused_roundtrip`
- `TestFusedSwiGLUDistGemmComposition.test_overlapping_variant_keeps_w13_checkpoint_layout`
- `TestFusedSwiGLUHFAdapter.test_hf_adapter_roundtrip`

## Deleted tests and reasons

Each entry explains why the test is being removed. References to existing coverage identify retained tests.

<summary>Core CPU: 43 test functions</summary>

- `TestShouldPurge.test_defined_on_the_base_not_the_dcp_manager`: Remove because method ownership is not the purge contract; the remaining TestShouldPurge cases check rank, retention and folder conditions regardless of where the method lives.

+## Deciding Whether a PR Needs Tests
+
+When authoring or reviewing a PR, do not add a test automatically for every fix.
+
+- **Identify the gap.** Name the behavior existing tests miss; cite existing
+  coverage when it is sufficient.
+- **Extend before adding.** Prefer an existing test or integration configuration
+  over another fixture, file, or model/flag permutation.
+- **Check behavior independently.** Avoid config echoes, source/README greps,
+  private-layout snapshots, and assertions that only repeat mock calls.
+- **Keep meaningful regressions.** A specific combination can protect numerics,
+  gradients, checkpoints, collectives, or demonstrated performance requirements.
+  Delete redundant cases only after identifying the coverage that remains.
